content.json:
# Fivetran - Log Overview
Overview of Fivetran platform and connector logs ingested into Microsoft Sentinel via the Logs Ingestion API (Fivetran_CL).

content.query:
Fivetran_CL
| summarize Count = count() by Level
| render piechart
content.title: Events by level

content.query:
Fivetran_CL
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), Level
| render timechart
content.title: Event volume over time

content.query:
Fivetran_CL
| where Level == 'SEVERE'
| project TimeGenerated, Level, Message
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Recent SEVERE events

content.json:
## Ingestion volume and cost
Billed volume by log level over the last 30 days. Routine INFO events typically dominate the volume while driving none of the detections in this solution. See VOLUME-AND-COST.md for the options, including splitting the feed across the Analytics and Auxiliary table plans.

content.query:
Fivetran_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize BilledGB = round(sum(_BilledSize) / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 3), Events = count() by Level
| extend PercentOfVolume = round(100.0 * BilledGB / toscalar(Fivetran_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | summarize round(sum(_BilledSize) / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 3)), 1)
| sort by BilledGB desc
content.title: Billed volume by level (30 days)

content.query:
Fivetran_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize BilledGB = round(sum(_BilledSize) / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 3) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), Level
| render columnchart
content.title: Daily billed GB by level

content.query:
Fivetran_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize LowValueGB = round(sumif(_BilledSize, Level !in ('WARNING', 'SEVERE')) / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 3), DetectionGB = round(sumif(_BilledSize, Level in ('WARNING', 'SEVERE')) / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 3)
| extend PercentLowValue = round(100.0 * LowValueGB / (LowValueGB + DetectionGB), 1)
| project LowValueGB, DetectionGB, PercentLowValue
content.title: Split-plan opportunity (volume that could move to the Auxiliary tier)
